overview_description.description: Moonset Health develops healthcare software that uses artificial intelligence to automate charting and documentation for hospice and post-acute care teams. Its platform functions as an ambient digital scribe that records nurse and care team encounters, transcribes audio, and generates clinical-grade visit and interdisciplinary group notes. The system is tuned to hospice and post-acute regulatory frameworks, incorporating LCD and CMS requirements to surface clinical eligibility indicators and highlight documentation gaps. Moonset Health integrates with electronic health record systems so notes and patient data stay synchronized across existing workflows. The software is intended for nurses and multidisciplinary care staff in hospice, home health, and skilled nursing settings who need to reduce manual documentation time while maintaining detailed, compliant records. Organizations use the platform to streamline visit documentation, support audit readiness, and standardize chart quality across teams.
